sync_specs.note: Bootstrap case: openspec/specs/ was empty at archive time. All 8 capability deltas were pure ADDED Requirements; each became a freshly-created canonical baseline at openspec/specs/<capability>/spec.md. Future changes will delta against these. The 'added: 8' count is capability-level (8 new spec files); individual requirement-level counts are higher (each spec adds 5-25 requirements).
